column5: CLIENT AND BACKEND AGREE (aligned by a 2026-07-16 fix): both use rings [0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.65, 1.55, 3, 8] with weights easy [36,6,10,19,16,10,3] / normal [49,7,8,11,11,9,5] / hard [57,7,4,8,10,8,6] at ~95% RTP, difficulty being variance-only. FIGMA DISAGREES WITH BOTH: it shows PER-DIFFICULTY multiplier tables topping 8.5x / 63x / 500x, where the implementation has ONE shared table topping 8x - Hard is 62.5x out. Figma also says "Medium" where the code says "normal". Per the Chicken precedent (backend wins) the frames need re-cutting.
